name: Elixir of Suffering
summary: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon brews an experimental draught for the Royal Apothecary Society. Its work aims to create a virulent plague against living humans and the Scourge.

sections.title: Apothecary Experimentation
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon gathers raw reagents from the wilderness around ruined Tarren Mill and combines them into toxic draughts. The work follows the Royal Apothecary Society's overarching mandate to formulate a new plague that will exterminate the living and the dead alike. To test the brew's potency, Lydon gives it to his assistant, a frog named Umpi.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Elixir of Suffering?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon brews the elixir as an experiment for the Royal Apothecary Society. The Society intends its new plague to eradicate living humans and the Scourge.
Umpi is a frog kept by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill. Though jokingly called his assistant, Umpi is an unwitting test subject for newly brewed alchemical toxins.

faq.q: What happens when Umpi drinks the elixir?
faq.answer: When Umpi drinks the Elixir of Suffering, the frog croaks and almost instantly succumbs to the poison. The test shows how deadly Lydon's brew is.

angles.text: Across Lordaeron, the Royal Apothecary Society works to create a weapon that will secure the Forsaken's independence from the Scourge and living humanity. Lydon's experiments in Tarren Mill are one step in that work.
